name: tnsr
description: TNSR monorepo scripts (Python core/server via uv, Studio UI via npm workspaces)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,magenta "uv run tnsr serve --reload" "npm --workspace tnsr_ui run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && uv run tnsr serve
scripts.demo:data: uv run tnsr data prepare --name demo
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && npm --workspace tnsr_ui run lint && npm --workspace tnsr_ui run typecheck
